_comment: LDIC built-in menu theme 'launcher': a game-launcher layout. Top bar with the pack name and secondary buttons, a large Play button, and optional cards for a featured server (live status) and news (a text file on the web). Set server_address / server_name / news_url in 'constants' to turn the cards on.
name: Launcher
author: Mica Technologies
description: Top bar, big Play button, live server card and news card.

children.text: {server_online(server_address) ? server_players(server_address) + ' / ' + server_max_players(server_address) + ' online  ·  ' + server_ping(server_address) + ' ms' : 'Offline or unreachable'}
